tasks.title: Initialize TypeScript monorepo
tasks.objective: Create root npm workspace and Vite React web, Fastify server, shared contracts. Locked dependencies, no remote runtime integrations.
acceptance: Root npm workspaces include apps/web, apps/server, packages/contracts.
Local dev boots two processes with proxy and production serves SPA from same origin.
No CDN, external fonts, Firebase, hosted APIs or copied clone sources.

tasks.title: Create quality and test foundation
tasks.objective: Install configured lint, formatter, Vitest tests, dev scripts and .env validation.
acceptance: npm scripts work: lint, typecheck, test, build, dev, start, db:migrate, seed:demo, test:e2e, verify:all.
Vitest contains nontrivial sample contract test and test runner returns nonzero on failure.
Server config validates HOST, PORT, DATA_DIR and defaults to loopback.

tasks.title: Implement SQLite migrations
tasks.objective: SQLite schema, WAL, FK enforcement, indexed queries, migration and safe local paths.
acceptance: All tables in docs/SCHEMA.md exist with required foreign keys and uniqueness constraints.
Migrations are idempotent; tests prove a new DB can be initialized and reopened.
.local-data is ignored; runtime NEVER fetches remote storage.

tasks.title: Implement local registration and sessions
tasks.objective: Server-side scrypt password auth, session cookies, login/logout/me and Origin checks.
acceptance: Register/login/me/logout works against SQLite; revoked/expired sessions fail.
Use secure random salt and session token; store only session token hashes.
Denied routes return typed errors, not 200 JSON with faux success.

tasks.title: Implement core HTTP spaces, channels and message posting
tasks.objective: Real DB-backed CRUD foundation to support UI, with role checks and basic pagination.
acceptance: Authenticated owner can create spaces and channels and post/query messages.
Message ordering uses transactional per-channel sequence and idempotent client nonce.
Cross-space access denied; integration tests cover one allow and one deny.

tasks.title: Implement authored design tokens and app shell
tasks.objective: Establish SIDEBAND design system and responsive original layout from design/VISUAL_DIRECTION.md.
acceptance: Real CSS tokens; sidebar, header and content stage display at 1440 and 390px.
No copied Discord assets, generic SaaS card grids, neon or remote fonts.
Layout can handle long names, scroll states and keyboard focus.

tasks.title: Build sign-in and registration screens
tasks.objective: Usable forms connected to actual local auth API with validation and real session.
acceptance: New account creation and session restoration work across refresh.
Errors are shown inline with accessible labels; no stubbed success state.
Authenticated navigation redirects to the app.

tasks.title: Build space and channel navigation
tasks.objective: Wire space switcher, channel list and create flows to server-side APIs.
acceptance: Spaces and channels created through UI survive reload.
Member can navigate among spaces and channels with visible active states.
Empty space/channel designs exist and all create actions work.

tasks.title: Build message stage and composer
tasks.objective: Build timestamp-grouped message feed, keyboard composer, history pagination and optimistic-safe send.
acceptance: Send writes to server, not localStorage; refresh returns all messages.
Long messages wrap, code blocks render safely, composer supports keyboard.
No duplicated messages after retry with same nonce.

tasks.title: Build member sidebar and contextual dialogs
tasks.objective: Original member panel, channel details, profile/preferences, command and modal treatment.
acceptance: Member sidebar displays real membership data; dialogs close on Escape, trap focus where appropriate.
Controls that exist are wired to functionality or visibly disabled as future work.
No inert interactive buttons misleading user.

tasks.title: Polish responsive and UI states
tasks.objective: Mobile channel drawer, no overflow, designed loading/error/disconnected/empty states and screenshots.
acceptance: At 320/390/768/1024/1440 widths no blocked composer or horizontal overflow.
Keyboard focus visible; reduced-motion respected.
Capture screenshots; HUMAN must inspect actual visuals before phase approval.

tasks.title: Implement invitations and account joining
tasks.objective: Secure scoped token-based invites with expiry, usage cap, join flow and audit.
acceptance: Owner generates invite; second user redeems into a space.
Expired/revoked/overused invite rejected; plaintext tokens never persisted.
Redemption atomic under concurrent requests.

tasks.title: Implement real roles and private channel grants
tasks.objective: Complete owner/admin/member permission matrix and channel membership.
acceptance: Private channel read/create/search/socket denied for unauthorized members.
Owner cannot be demoted/removed by others, role operations audited.
Server uses one centralized authorization service.

tasks.title: Implement edit/delete and cursor pagination
tasks.objective: Message editing, soft deletion, history paging with server canonical ordering.
acceptance: User can edit/delete own messages, administrator can moderate, others denied.
History paging neither skips nor duplicates boundary messages.
Deleted message remains tombstone and no original content leaks to client.

tasks.title: Implement search and persisted read cursors
tasks.objective: Permission-filtered message search and per-user channel read positions.
acceptance: Search runs against SQLite and excludes inaccessible private channels.
Results jump to correct message and highlight match.
Unread count survives page reload and is per-user/per-channel.

tasks.title: Implement local attachment lifecycle
tasks.objective: Locally stored, validated files with authenticated retrieval and secure deletion.
acceptance: File size/type/filename and path traversal tests; only authorized readers can fetch.
Uploads are local disk, filenames sanitized; metadata saved in SQLite.
UI shows progress, errors, preview for safe types only.

tasks.title: Authenticate WebSocket subscriptions
tasks.objective: Socket.IO attached to Fastify with sessions, per-room authorization and typed events.
acceptance: Anonymous/expired user rejected at handshake; unauthorized room denied.
Server and client share contracts; CORS/Origin bounded to local approved origins.
Subscriptions are cleaned on disconnect.

tasks.title: Implement real-time two-user messaging
tasks.objective: Broadcast message create/edit/delete after DB commit, across separate browser contexts.
acceptance: User B sees A send without refresh; message order consistent with persisted state.
Server-side events only after committed writes.
Separate authenticated clients, not a simulated single-user demo.

tasks.title: Implement reconnect, deduplication and backlog
tasks.objective: Online/offline transitions, fetch missed events, no duplicate messages or stale cursors.
acceptance: Server restart/reconnect recovers all persisted messages.
Send retry with identical clientNonce does not create duplicate.
Disconnected state clear; UI offers retry and handles invalid session.

tasks.title: Implement ephemeral typing and presence
tasks.objective: Bounded typing/presence signals with debounce and user privacy.
acceptance: Typing transitions not stored as messages; disconnect clears presence.
Server validates membership, rate limits ephemeral actions.
Two browser contexts show consistent indicators.

tasks.title: Synchronize roles and channels in real time
tasks.objective: Membership changes invalidate subscriptions and client navigation immediately.
acceptance: Removing access ejects user from subscribed private room promptly.
Edited/archived channels propagate to authorized clients.
HTTP and Socket.IO access-control tests pass concurrently.

tasks.title: Expand unit and integration tests
tasks.objective: Coverage for core permissions, migrations, idempotency, sessions and contract validity.
acceptance: Unit+integration tests use temporary SQLite DB; test failures must block progress.
Negative paths, edge cases and race conditions tested.
No test skips to force green.

tasks.title: Create two-context Playwright E2E tests
tasks.objective: Real browser tests with separate contexts, local backend and seed fixture.
acceptance: Two independent contexts register, invite, chat, reload and observe live delivery.
Permission denial tested through UI and direct HTTP/WS.
Screenshots saved for UI review and test:e2e exits on failures.

tasks.title: Harden security and API error handling
tasks.objective: Complete rate limits, schema validation, XSS, origin and auth negatives.
acceptance: Unauthorized read/search/attachments/socket tests fail safely.
Safe HTML rendering and bounded request payloads.
Session revocation and invite expiry tested.

tasks.title: Accessibility and interaction quality
tasks.objective: Keyboard operation, dialogs, accessible labels and reduced-motion.
acceptance: Tab/Enter/Escape controls major screens; focus not lost after navigation.
Contrast and legibility checked; no blocked composer at 320px.
Automated accessibility assertions plus human UX review.

tasks.title: Run offline, performance and durability tests
tasks.objective: Verify no remote calls, 500+ messages scroll, restart consistency, query indexes.
acceptance: Network inspect shows local connections only, disconnected WAN mode works.
Seed 500+ messages; message timeline remains responsive.
Restart maintains messages, users and invite state.

tasks.title: Finalize reproducible demo seed and reset
tasks.objective: One-command DB migration/demo seed/reset with safe deletion rules and original data.
acceptance: npm run db:migrate and seed:demo work on clean checkout.
Two demo accounts and sample channels demonstrate real interactions.
Credentials not committed and reset refuses unsafe path.

tasks.title: Implement opt-in LAN demo
tasks.objective: Server binds loopback by default, offers deliberate DEMO_LAN mode for same-Wi-Fi audience.
acceptance: DEFAULT host only 127.0.0.1; LAN mode only when explicitly set.
Client assets/API/sockets same-origin in production build.
Documented security and firewall limits; no tunnelling services.

tasks.title: Record test and visual evidence
tasks.objective: Complete final screenshots and verified tests; no fabricated or scripted-fake results.
acceptance: Record screenshots all target widths, two-user chat, permission failure and persisted reload.
Summary contains actual tested commands and known limitations.
HUMAN reviews visuals and functionality; no false claim of Discord backend recovery.

tasks.title: Sanitize and prepare OpenDeck release
tasks.objective: Make repo documentation, license, cleanup and local setup robust, without actually publishing.
acceptance: All root commands execute on clean checkout after npm install.
No secrets, non-original assets, private test data or remote runtime dependencies.
Open source release README accurate; human controls when GitHub/OpenDeck listing goes live.
